name: lumi-skill-finance-office
description: Read-only finance workbench for reconciliation, ratio and variance analysis, statement consistency checks, cash-flow forecasts, tax workpapers, and management reporting.

lumi.setupNote: For deterministic reconciliation, financial analysis, budgeting, statement checks, bookkeeping, and tax workpaper support. Financial and tax reports should be reviewed by finance/accounting staff.

sideEffects.scope: in-process calculation over user-provided financial inputs

limitations: Calculations are workpaper aids and require finance or accounting review before external use.
